Container.Name: Hearth
Container.Overview: Self-hosted home manager by Alan Nicholas: recurring maintenance reminders, room-by-room inventory, photos, documents and manuals, contractors, budget and replacement forecasting, schedule with Google Calendar sync, shopping lists and pantry, vehicles, projects, fast capture (barcode, labels, receipts), a REST API for the Android app, and Tailscale remote access. Notifications via Apprise (ntfy, Discord, email, Pushover...).

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Optional: pre-creates this owner account on first start. Leave blank to create it in the browser.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional: password for the pre-created owner account

Config.Name: Server URL for devices
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. https://hearth.your-tailnet.ts.net (auto-detected when Unraid's Use Tailscale is on)

Config.Name: Anthropic API key (photo reading)
Config.Description: Optional. Claude reads receipt and label photos; leave empty to read them in the browser

Config.Name: Claude model
Config.Description: Model for photo reading (e.g. claude-haiku-5-5 for lower cost)

Config.Name: Demo mode
Config.Description: 1 = sample data in /data/demo (your real data is untouched)

Config.Name: Reminder lead days
Config.Description: Notify this many days before a task is due

Config.Name: Check interval (hours)
Config.Description: How often to check for due tasks (each task notifies at most once per day)
